# Erosion Magus (Spirit Magus)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Skills affected:** Summon Erosion Magus, Scattered Mud, Bleak Grass, Withering Payback, World of Thorns, Harvest Time
- **Mechanic tags:** minion, spirit-magus, erosion, conversion, uptime, shotgun

## Derived / confirmed formula

Scattered Mud and Bleak Grass share the Base cast rate, split by Enhanced replacement chance. The Empower cast-slot factor max(0, 1 - 0.5 * effective Empower cast time / effective Empower cooldown) is applied to unmerged Base and Enhanced rates and exposed with effective Empower timing in the minion_empower payload for Iris merged-rate math; Harvest Time sets the effective cast time to zero. Bleak Grass delivers its spike and explosion at full damage. The Stage 4 extra spike is modeled only when the erosion_stage4_extra_spike condition is explicitly enabled (default off). Withering Payback contributes its +20% additional Erosion Damage buff and Growth Stage 4+ +50% additional Ultimate Damage, each scaled by Empower Effect and uptime. Uptime uses duration increased by Minion Skill Effect Duration divided by cooldown reduced by Minion CDR and Spirit Magus CDR; Empower Effect scales buff magnitude, not duration or cooldown. Empower cooldown uses generic Minion CDR and Spirit Magus CDR. World of Thorns is retained as one per-cast hit form and excluded from default DPS until a selecting trait/dispatcher consumes it. Physical damage converts to Erosion through the player conversion cascade.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Engine status remains unverified by source. Tested in game by owner: at level 16 and 18% Enhanced chance with Empower auto-casting, the owner measured about 118 target DPS. The no-cast-slot engine result was 118.579216 (rounds to 119); applying the 0.97 cast-slot factor gives 115.02183952 (rounds to 115). The owner will retest this discrepancy; keep the 0.5 efficiency unchanged pending that result. Tested in game by owner: Bleak Grass spike and explosion both hit the same target for full damage with no falloff; World of Thorns hits each enemy once even when thorns overlap. OWNER TO CONFIRM: at Growth Stage 4+, the erosion_stage4_extra_spike condition models an exact extra spike recast with no damage penalty or added cast time; the condition defaults off. The erosion_stage4_extra_spike condition and this verification source entry must be added in a separate tli-data PR before the condition is player-selectable or the entry survives regeneration; no dedicated data PR is open yet (https://github.com/Tyrayla/tli-data). Withering Payback's damage-triggered cast is ignored because Magi do not practically take damage. SS14 shared minion base stats are a stopgap ported from SS12 pending in-game remeasurement. Harvest Time's canonical Preparation effect is modeled as an instant Empower cast.
